name: clpr-explainer
description: The plumbing of CLPR: a two-page explainer built into the website at /plumbing/.

scripts.check:browser: kse check-scroll && kse check-sims && node checks/browser/check-diagram-text.mjs
scripts.verify: astro build && kse check && node checks/check-detail.mjs && kse check-anchors && kse check-scroll && kse check-sims && DARK=1 kse check-sims && node checks/browser/check-diagram-text.mjs && kse overflow / 400 && kse overflow /developers/ 400 && pnpm run check:dark
scripts.check:dark: export THEME=dark NODE_OPTIONS=--require=./checks/browser/theme-preload.cjs && kse check-sims && node checks/browser/check-diagram-text.mjs && kse overflow / 400 && kse overflow /developers/ 400
